name: Thorns Beneath the Wings
source:
Sereneth, a powerful fairy born of ancient magic, left behind her timeless realm to walk beside the man she loves: Caelen, a noble and loyal human warrior. Bound by love, they accept a royal mission—rescue the human king’s daughter, kidnapped by a rogue elven lord.

Their journey leads them through the mystical Forest of Myrlaen, where magic lingers in every shadow and danger hides behind every tree. Along the way, they meet Olgrun, a grotesque but strangely wise man who claims to know the only safe path.

With no choice but to trust him, Sereneth and Caelen begin a journey that will test not only their strength, but the very core of their bond.

As they press on, something darker begins to bloom: lingering stares, suggestive words, and choices that blur the lines between loyalty and temptation. Love remains—but something is beginning to crack.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/Aleksandr14/posts/first-release-v0-130374380]Patreon[/url]]
